purpose: Engineering cohort test parameters only; not a validated screening or diagnostic rule.
person_count: Registry entities per site. Source rows do not establish unique real people.
latest_specimen: Latest date then lexical specimen ID among accepted observations in the interval, before testing CBC completeness.
hplc: All three HPLC tests present on the selected specimen, including valid censored results.
missing: Incomplete CBC is excluded from the complete denominator; missing HPLC means no complete HPLC panel recorded in this export.
dedup: Collapse identical reexports. Highest final revision per specimen and test wins.
